overview:
The Trade Federation Directorate is the Neimoidian board commanding Trade Federation blockades, battle droid armies, and occupation administrations — most infamously during the Naboo invasion led by [Nute Gunray](characters/nute-gunray). The Directorate claims corporate sovereignty while deploying military assets that rival planetary defense forces.

See also the Trade Federation faction profile for full wartime fleet history.
history:
Neimoidian merchant lords built the Directorate to manage droid manufacturing subsidiaries and shipping cartels from Cato Neimoidia vault-world palaces. [Nute Gunray](characters/nute-gunray) and [Rune Haako](characters/nute-gunray) — titles contested in archives — orchestrated the Naboo blockade that forced [Padmé Amidala](characters/padme-amidala) to seek Republic intervention.

[Darth Sidious](sith/darth-sidious) manipulated the Directorate as early Separatist muscle, ensuring battle droid output continued through [Geonosis](planet/geonosis) foundries. [Count Dooku](sith/darth-tyranus) later seated Gunray on the Separatist Council.

[Anakin Skywalker](jedi/anakin-skywalker) and [Obi-Wan Kenobi](jedi/obi-wan-kenobi) fought Federation droid armies across the Clone Wars until the Directorate leadership died on Mustafar with other Separatist executives.

**Key figures and documented associations.** Archives tie Trade Federation Directorate operations to [Nute Gunray](characters/nute-gunray), [Padmé Amidala](characters/padme-amidala), [Jar Jar Binks](characters/jar-jar-binks), [Captain Panaka](characters/captain-panaka), [Obi-Wan Kenobi](jedi/obi-wan-kenobi), [Anakin Skywalker](jedi/anakin-skywalker), [Darth Sidious](sith/darth-sidious), [Darth Tyranus](sith/darth-tyranus). Testimony from captains, senators, and hunter guild boards repeatedly name these individuals when reconstructing supply routes, succession disputes, and covert payroll networks — even when official holonews omitted the organization's role.

Intelligence annexes recommend cross-referencing their personal profiles when investigating Trade Federation Directorate contracts, as individual loyalties often explain faction shifts that corporate ledgers alone cannot clarify.

**Territory and headquarters.** Primary operational worlds include Cato Neimoidia, Naboo. Local customs officials, shadow-port syndics, and planetary governors maintained uneasy coexistence with Trade Federation Directorate agents — taxing, bribing, or outsourcing enforcement depending on which side held the garrison that season.
significance:
The Trade Federation Directorate is the archetype of corporate belligerence — blockade as policy, droids as occupation troops.

Naboo's invasion remains mandatory study in Republic military academies.

**Documented across galactic media.** Trade Federation Directorate appears in canonical records tied to Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace; Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones; Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith; Star Wars: The Clone Wars; Star Wars: The Bad Batch. Each appearance reinforces how the organization intersects with major wars, underworld economies, and Force-era purges — not as background color but as decision-making institutions with payrolls, territory, and succession law.
